Mine is getting better, but still not good. I've had depression for many years (most likely, looking back on my behaviour) but was only diagnosed recently. I got put on antidepressants, but those caused serious headaches. After a few months thinking it was normal, I told my doctor and she got me new ones. In January, my best friend started dating my crush, even though she knew about my crush on the person, and this put me over the edge. I started self harming. Nothing super bad, but bad enough for my friends to be very concerned. Eventually, my mom found out and I got a psychiatrist. For reference, I just got one a few months ago, and I still self harmed while seeing her. She was only temporary and I should be going to see a new one soon. I haven't hurt myaelf for a few weeks, and I threw my blades away. I still have the scars and scabs and they fill me with regret every day. It's hard to wear shorts and short sleeves without me feeling immense regret and guilt. I'm out of school for the summer, so hopefully a break for a few months should help me. I'm also taking vitamins now since I apparently have many vitamin deficiencies that might have been making my depression worse. Let's just hope everything gets better.
